items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Oh, yes, he was a good accompanist.

ctx.x: What's his name? I can never think of this guy's name. I always have to ask George Devivier what his name is.

But what was her husband's name, the arranger and bandleader? Lena's husband? Some Italian name, wasn't it? Oh, let's not waste time on that. Everybody knows so it doesn't matter. It doesn't even matter who the piano player was. The main thing was, he played nice accompaniment for her.
Oh, yes, he was a good accompanist.
